description: A calm, organic living room corner photographed at standing eye-level with a normal lens, showing a three-quarter view of two walls converging. The walls are finished in smooth warm plaster in a soft greige-cream tone. A large window on the upper left allows bright natural light to rake across the textured plaster wall. The floor is covered with a chunky woven natural jute rug in sandy honey tone. At the center-left, a generously proportioned slipcovered armchair in warm sand linen with a full, loose cushion construction is dressed with a relaxed linen throw and two simple pillows. Behind the chair, a mature compact olive tree in a simple pot adds organic sculptural form and silvery green foliage. To the right, a small open-shelf side table in dark espresso-stained oak holds a round ceramic vase with loose dried berry branches, a small round sculptural object, and a stack of books. On the wall to the upper right, a curated gallery of three framed botanical prints in warm wooden frames forms a composed arrangement. A warm, diffuse glow radiates from the floor-standing form beside the chair — a tall column that emits soft ambient warmth at waist height and below, illuminating the surrounding jute rug and the back of the chair from that level. The palette is warm and natural: sand, plaster greige, honey jute, dark espresso, and soft organic green.
